column3: With respect to the 1500 Post Oak Boulevard Mortgage Loan (4.0%), the sole tenant, Woodside Energy, has a right of first offer (“ROFO”) to purchase the subject Mortgaged Property if the borrower intends to market the Mortgaged Property for sale so long as (i) Woodside Energy is leasing at least 75% of the rentable square feet in the premises and (ii) no significant event of default under the Woodside Energy lease exists. The ROFO is not extinguished by foreclosure; however, the ROFO does not apply to foreclosure or deed in lieu thereof.
